rci1_using_msad.detail: Single-site harmonized MRI data; all participants scanned on the same 3-Tesla Siemens TIM Trio scanner
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "Herein, we developed the normative model of WM microstructural property (generalized fractional anisotropy, GFA), as a function of age, across the lifespan using large-sampled single-site harmonized cross-sectional MRI data from more than 600 typically developing individuals (5 -40 yrs) [17]."
